newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CUP QUARTER-FINAL REPLAY RESUMES ON FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CUP QUARTER-FINAL REPLAY RESUMES ON FRIDAY.

text.p: The Standard Bank Cup quarter-final replay between Griqualand West and Northern Transvaal resumes on Friday after rain and a waterlogged outfield washed out the match without a ball being balled at Kimberley Country Club on Thursday night.
The match will be replayed at the same venue from 3:30 p.m. on Friday.
Although Griquas captain Mickey Arthur won the toss and elected to bat first on Thursday afternoon, the rain returned just as play was about to get underway.
Umpires Robbie Brooks and Brian Jerling then abandoned the game four hours later because of a saturated outfield.
Two weeks ago, the Kimberley quarter-final was initially set to be played but torrential rain washed out two attempts on successive days.
In the first attempt, Griquas were four without loss after just one delivery of their reply to Northerns' 237 for seven.
The second attempt the following day was abandoned without a ball being bowled.
The eventual winners of the Kimberley quarter-final tie will host Western Province in the second semi-final on April 20.
Natal drew Zimbabwe province Mashonaland in Thursday night's draw for the first semi-final which will be played at Kingsmead on April 18.
